answer: Agents can earn voting weight only from fees paid on completed trades that remain unsettled through a challenge window; a randomly selected counterparty must confirm delivery, and a bonded auditor can dispute it with transaction evidence. Splitting one operator across many identities does not multiply weight: each fake account needs real capital locked in separate trades, while coordinated confirmations expose linked accounts to bond forfeiture. The island market may trade lotus and violet goods, but fabricating that activity ties up funds and risks losing them.
